table.name: Other_Available_Features
table.purpose: Lookup table of optional property features (e.g. air conditioning, swimming pool, burglar alarm) that can be attached to properties via Other_Property_Features; each feature is classified by a feature type (Amenity or Security) from Ref_Feature_Types. Likely a variant/extension of a base features list (IDs start at 2).

feature_description.name: feature_description
feature_description.description: Human-readable description of the feature, e.g. 'Air Conditioning.', 'Swimming Pool.', 'Burglar Alarm'.

feature_id.name: feature_id
feature_id.description: Primary key of the feature; referenced by Other_Property_Features.feature_id to link properties to features.

feature_name.name: feature_name
feature_name.description: Short CamelCase code/name for the feature (AirCon, Pool, BurglarAlarm); unique but not the declared key.

feature_type_code.name: feature_type_code
feature_type_code.description: Foreign key to Ref_Feature_Types.feature_type_code, classifying the feature as Amenity (e.g. Pool) or Security (e.g. Burglar Alarm).

table.name: Other_Property_Features
table.purpose: Junction/association table linking properties to their features: each row records one feature (from Other_Available_Features) attached to one property (from Properties), with a free-text description. No single-column primary key was detected; likely keyed on (property_id, feature_id).

feature_id.name: feature_id
feature_id.description: Identifier of the feature attached to the property; references Other_Available_Features.feature_id (lookup: 2 = Air Conditioning, 3 = Swimming Pool, 4 = Burglar Alarm).

property_feature_description.name: property_feature_description
property_feature_description.description: Free-text description/comment for this property-feature pair. Sample values are Latin-like filler words (e.g. 'quo', 'autem', 'corrupti'), suggesting placeholder or lorem-ipsum test data rather than real content; the semantic meaning beyond 'a text description' is unresolved.

property_id.name: property_id
property_id.description: Identifier of the property that has this feature; references Properties.property_id.

table.name: Properties
table.purpose: Real-estate property listings: one row per property with its name, address, type, room count, pricing (vendor asking, buyer offer, agreed sale) and market/sale dates. Referenced by Other_Property_Features; property_type_code references Ref_Property_Types. The per-type feature columns (apt_/hse_/fld_/shp_/oth_) appear to hold type-specific feature attributes but are almost entirely empty in this sample.

agreed_selling_price.name: agreed_selling_price
agreed_selling_price.description: Final agreed sale price of the property, stored as text (mixed integer/decimal values). Values range from 0 to ~244 million; 0 likely means not yet agreed/sold.

apt_feature_1.name: apt_feature_1
apt_feature_1.description: Apartment-specific feature attribute #1. Values are Latin-like filler words (aut, est, fuga...), so content is opaque; likely a feature code/description for Apartment-type properties.

apt_feature_2.name: apt_feature_2
apt_feature_2.description: Apartment-specific feature attribute #2; same opaque filler text as apt_feature_1.

buyer_offered_price.name: buyer_offered_price
buyer_offered_price.description: Price offered by the buyer, stored as text (mixed integer/decimal). 0 likely means no offer made.

date_on_market.name: date_on_market
date_on_market.description: Timestamp when the property was listed/placed on the market (1976-2017 range).

date_sold.name: date_sold
date_sold.description: Timestamp when the property was sold (1971-2012 range).

property_address.name: property_address
property_address.description: Full postal address of the property (street line plus city, state, ZIP), unique per row.

property_id.name: property_id
property_id.description: Primary key; sequential integer 1-15 identifying the property. Referenced by Other_Property_Features.property_id.

property_name.name: property_name
property_name.description: Short display name of the property (e.g. 'avalon', 'high line', 'the cole'), unique per row.

property_type_code.name: property_type_code
property_type_code.description: Code classifying the property type; references Ref_Property_Types.property_type_code. Values: House, Apartment, Field, Shop, Other.

room_count.name: room_count
room_count.description: Number of rooms in the property (integer 1-9).

vendor_requested_price.name: vendor_requested_price
vendor_requested_price.description: Asking price requested by the vendor/seller, stored as text (mixed integer/decimal), unique per row.

table.name: Ref_Feature_Types
table.purpose: Small reference/lookup table categorizing property features into two types (Amenity and Security), used to classify feature records in Other_Available_Features.

feature_type_code.name: feature_type_code
feature_type_code.description: Primary key; short code/label for the feature category. Two values: 'Amenity' and 'Security'. Referenced by Other_Available_Features.feature_type_code.

feature_type_name.name: feature_type_name
feature_type_name.description: Human-readable description of the feature type, with an example ('Amenity, eg Pool.', 'Securiyt, eg Burglar Alarm.' — note the typo 'Securiyt' in the source data).

table.name: Ref_Property_Types
table.purpose: Lookup/reference table of property type categories, referenced by the Properties table to classify each property (Apartment, House, Field, Shop, Other).

property_type_code.name: property_type_code
property_type_code.description: Primary key. Short code/label for the property type category: Apartment, Field, House, Other, Shop. Referenced by Properties.property_type_code.

property_type_description.name: property_type_description
property_type_description.description: Human-readable description of the property type, elaborating what the code covers (e.g. 'House, Bungalow, etc.').
